app.name: La Hotte
app.tagline: Everyone’s wishes, and the surprise kept safe.

login.title: Sign in
login.who: Nobody else sees what you type here.

register.title: Create an account
register.who: Your address is only used to sign you in and write to you; it is never shown to others.
register.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. An easy-to-remember phrase makes a good password.
register.displayNameHint: People in your circle will see this name. You can change it later.
register.sentBody: If {email} can receive an account, a verification link has just been sent to it. It stays valid for a limited time.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.who: We write to the account’s address, without saying whether it exists.
forgot.sentBody: Open the link in the email to choose a new password. All open sessions will be closed.

reset.title: New password
reset.who: Only you see this field. All your open sessions will be closed.
reset.doneHint: You can sign in again with the new one.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your address
verifyEmail.who: This confirmation shows nothing to anyone.
verifyEmail.done: Address confirmed. You can sign in.
verifyEmail.notYou: You did not create this account or do not know its password?

cancelEmailChange.title: Cancel the address change
cancelEmailChange.who: You are receiving this because this address was the account’s.
cancelEmailChange.doneHint: As a precaution, all sessions of the account were closed. If it was not you, change your password too.

errors.emailInvalid: This address does not look valid.
errors.displayNameInvalid: Give a name of 1 to 60 characters.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: This address is not confirmed yet. Open the link sent by email.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.PASSWORD_BREACHED: This password appears in known leaks. Choose another one.
errors.AGE_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED: Tick the box to confirm your age.
errors.INVITATION_REQUIRED: Sign-up is by invitation only for now.
errors.INVITATION_INVALID: This invitation is no longer valid.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is briefly unavailable. Try again in a moment.
errors.TOTP_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED: This account must first enable a second factor.
errors.network: The server is not responding. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
errors.REAUTH_REQUIRED: First confirm that it is you.
errors.TOTP_ALREADY_ENABLED: The second factor is already enabled.
errors.TOTP_NOT_ENABLED: The second factor is not enabled.
errors.TOTP_MANDATORY: This account has a role that requires the second factor: it cannot disable it.
errors.LAST_PROFILE: The last profile of an account cannot be deleted.
errors.PROFILE_LIMIT_REACHED: An account cannot have more than 10 profiles. Delete one to create another.
errors.PIN_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
errors.EMAIL_TOO_RECENT: This address was just changed. Wait before changing it again.
errors.VERSION_MISMATCH: This item was changed elsewhere. Reload the page.
errors.CHILD_EMAIL_FORBIDDEN: A child profile has no email address.
errors.INVITATION_LIMIT_REACHED: You have reached the number of open invitations. Withdraw one.
errors.INVITATION_TARGET_INVALID: This account cannot host a profile.
errors.PROFILE_INVITATION_FORBIDDEN: Your profile cannot invite someone to create a profile.
errors.GOOGLE_ALREADY_LINKED: A Google account is already linked.
errors.GOOGLE_UNAVAILABLE: Google is not responding. Try again in a moment.
errors.GOOGLE_IDENTITY_TAKEN: This Google account is already linked to another account.
errors.TRANSFER_CONSENT_UNSAFE: For your safety, consent is refused for 7 days after a PIN or profile address change.
errors.TRANSFER_PENDING: A request is already in progress for this profile.
errors.TRANSFER_PIN_CHOICE_INVALID: This PIN choice is not possible.
errors.DETACH_CHILD_FORBIDDEN: A child profile cannot be detached.
errors.UNDECLARED_REGROUP: This move would delete the account: declare the regrouping.
errors.HAS_WARDS: This account is a guardian: it cannot be deleted or regrouped.
errors.GUARDIAN_REQUIRED: This change would leave an account without an adult.
errors.WARD_CHILD_ONLY: A ward account only holds child profiles.
errors.WARD_NOT_FOUND: This ward account does not exist.
errors.WARD_RELEASE_NOT_REQUESTED: Your guardian has not asked to lift the guardianship.
errors.WARD_RELEASE_SINGLE_PROFILE: Guardianship can only be lifted for an account with a single profile.
errors.ACCOUNT_SETUP_INVALID: This setup link is no longer valid.
errors.INVALID_PROFILE: This profile is not valid for this action.
errors.LINK_SAME_ACCOUNT: Both profiles are in the same account.
errors.PROFILE_LOCKED: This profile is locked. Enter its PIN.

verifyProfileEmail.title: Confirm the profile address
verifyProfileEmail.who: This confirmation shows nothing to anyone.

cancelTransfer.title: Cancel the account change
cancelTransfer.who: You are receiving this because your profile was about to change account.
cancelTransfer.doneHint: Your profile stays in its current account.

session.unreachable: The server is not responding. Check your connection, then reload the page.
session.offlinePinNeedsNetwork: You're offline. This profile is protected by a code: reopening it needs a connection.
session.offlineNothing: You're offline and nothing has been saved on this device yet. Reconnect to get started.
session.profileUnreadable: Unable to check this profile. As a precaution, its content is not shown. Check your connection, then try again.

nav.label: Main navigation
nav.signOutQueueTitle: Some actions haven't been sent yet
nav.signOutQueueBody: {count, plural, one {One action made offline will be lost} other {# actions made offline will be lost}} if you sign out now.

home.who: Only you can see this screen.

noPin.title: This profile has no PIN
noPin.body: Without a PIN, anyone who opens this account can enter this profile. A PIN mostly protects surprises between profiles of the same account.

waiting.title: {count, plural, one {A link is waiting for your approval} other {# links are waiting for your approval}}

soon.title: Your lists
soon.body: “My wishes” and your other lists are waiting for you.

transfer.title: An account change request concerns you
transfer.body: Your profile is about to change account. Read the request: you can refuse it at any time before it runs.

secondFactor.title: Second factor
secondFactor.who: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code. Nobody else sees this field.
secondFactor.codeHint: Six digits, or a recovery code.
secondFactor.codeInvalid: Enter a code of 6 to 32 characters.
secondFactor.wrongCode: This code is not right. It changes every 30 seconds: enter the one shown now.
secondFactor.expired: The 5-minute window has passed. Sign in again with your password.

profiles.title: Who is looking?
profiles.who: Choose the profile to open. A protected profile asks for its PIN.
profiles.unlockWho: Enter the PIN to reopen this profile.
profiles.loadError: Unable to load the profiles. Reload the page.

pin.label: PIN
pin.who: PIN of the profile “{name}”. Nobody else sees what you type.
pin.wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.

errors.PIN_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
errors.network: The server is not responding. Try again.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

notice.title: Good to know before you enter
notice.reset: This profile’s PIN was reset or disabled from the Account space on {date}.
notice.failed: {count, plural, one {One wrong PIN was entered} other {# wrong PINs were entered}} since your last visit to this profile.
notice.advice: If it was not you, change the account password and set a new PIN.

reauth.title: Confirm it is you
reauth.who: This action is sensitive. Nobody else sees what you type.
reauth.codeHint: Code from the app, or a recovery code.

totp.title: Second factor (TOTP)
totp.who: A 6-digit code, renewed every 30 seconds by an authenticator app, is added to your password.
totp.disabled: The second factor is not enabled.
totp.enabled: {count, plural, =0 {Enabled. No recovery codes left: generate new ones.} one {Enabled. One recovery code is still valid.} other {Enabled. # recovery codes are still valid.}}
totp.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits shown by the app.

enroll.step1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
enroll.manual: This key is secret: do not share it with anyone.
enroll.orKey: No camera? Type this key into the app by hand:

codes.title: Recovery codes
codes.once: Keep them somewhere safe: they will never be shown again. Each works once, if you lose your app.

credentials.title: Email, password and Google
credentials.who: Only you can see these settings.
credentials.emailHint: A confirmation link goes to the new address; the old one is warned and can cancel.
credentials.emailSent: A confirmation link has just been sent.
credentials.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Other sessions will be closed.

google.title: Google
google.linked: This account can sign in with Google.
google.notLinked: Link Google to sign in without a password.

sessions.title: Open sessions
sessions.who: The devices signed in to this account. Only you see them.

trusted.title: Trusted devices
trusted.who: These devices skip the second factor for 30 days.

accountProfiles.title: Account profiles
accountProfiles.who: The Account space only shows management information: never a wish, a reservation or a comment.
accountProfiles.disablePinBody: The profile will be told on its next visit. Without a PIN, anyone who opens this account can enter it.
accountProfiles.newPinHint: 4 to 8 digits. The profile will be warned of the reset.
accountProfiles.deleteBody: The profile will be permanently deleted. The last profile of an account cannot be deleted.

accountPage.title: Account
accountPage.who: Your account is shared by all your profiles. These settings appear in no profile.

securityPage.title: Security
securityPage.who: Second factor, sessions and devices of this account. Only you see them.

proposals.title: Invitations to create a profile
proposals.who: Accepting adds a profile to this account. Declining does not tell the inviter why.
proposals.body: {name} offers you a profile in this account.
proposals.bodyChild: {name} offers you a child profile in this account.

settings.title: Profile settings
settings.who: Your circle sees your name and the birthday you enter. The language and the PIN are visible only to you.
settings.displayNameHint: People in your circle see it.
settings.birthdayHint: Day and month are enough; the year is optional.
settings.birthdayInvalid: Enter a day (1 to 31) and a month (1 to 12), or leave empty.
settings.currentPinHint: Needed to ask for the PIN less often.
settings.currentPinNeeded: Enter your current PIN to relax this setting.
settings.stale: This profile was changed elsewhere. The up-to-date values are shown: review, then save again.

notices.pinReset: This profile’s PIN was reset or disabled from the Account space on {date}.
notices.pinResetAdvice: If it was not you, change the account password. This notice stays until you set a new PIN.
notices.child: This profile’s “child profile” marker was changed from the Account space.

pin.title: Profile PIN
pin.who: The PIN protects this profile from the other profiles of the account. Only you know it.

email.title: Profile email address
email.who: Optional, never used to sign in nor searched. Only you see it; it is used to give your consent to a move or a detachment.
email.label: Email address
email.sent: A verification link has just been sent to this address.

circle.title: Circle
circle.who: People in your circle can see what you show them. A block is never revealed to the blocked person.

approve.title: Links to approve
approve.who: You approve a link for a child profile. Nothing opens before your consent.
approve.bodyGeneric: A link is waiting for your consent.

links.title: Links
links.who: Your links with profiles of other accounts.
links.none: No links yet. Invite someone from the Invitations screen.
links.removeBody: Access tied to this link is removed on the next request.

own.title: In your account
own.who: The other profiles of your account are part of your circle.

block.title: Block this profile?
block.body: The link is deleted and no invitation or visibility is possible between you. The person is not told.

blocks.title: Blocked profiles
blocks.who: Lifting a block does not restore the link.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.who: An invitation is a single-use link, valid for a few days.

new.title: New invitation
new.whoLink: The person who opens the link sees your name and can join your circle.
new.whoProfile: The person who opens the link creates a profile in the chosen account; that account must accept it.
new.emailHint: If you enter it, the link is sent to it; otherwise you get the link to pass on.
new.target: Account that will host the profile
new.child: The profile to create is a child’s

created.title: Invitation created
created.once: This link will not be shown again. It expires on {date}.

open.invalid: This link is no longer valid. Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
open.signInFirst: Sign in, or create an account, to open this invitation.
open.reopen: Once signed in, reopen the link you received.
open.linkBody: {name} invites you to join their circle. Each of you will see what the other chooses to show.
open.linked: Done: you are in the same circle.
open.linkedPendingGuardian: The link is waiting for a parent’s approval. Nothing opens before.
open.profileBody: {name} offers you a profile in their account.
open.profileBodyChild: {name} offers you a child profile in their account.
open.profilePinHint: 4 to 8 digits. You can add it later.
open.profileEmailHint: It is only used to receive a move or detachment request.
open.profileSent: Proposal sent: the account holder still has to accept it.

accountSetup.title: Set up your account
accountSetup.who: Choose a password: only you will know it.

transferConsent.title: Your consent
transferConsent.who: Your profile is changing account. This consent is seen only by you and the account holder.

setup.done: Account set up. You can sign in.

consent.pinChoice: What happens to this profile’s PIN?
consent.noneWarning: Without a PIN, anyone who opens the destination account can enter this profile and see its surprises.
consent.done: Consent recorded. The change happens after a 48-hour safety delay.

google.title: Back from Google
google.who: Google only confirms your email address; neither your name nor your photo is requested.
google.restart: Start again from the Account space: the confirmation of less than 10 minutes has expired.
google.registrationNeeded: No account exists for this address. To create one, give the name of your first profile and your age.
google.codeNeeded: Google recognised you. Enter your second-factor code to finish.

errors.GOOGLE_LINK_REQUIRED: An account already exists with this address. Sign in with your password, then link Google from the Account space.
errors.GOOGLE_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: Google did not confirm this email address. Use another way to sign in.
errors.GOOGLE_FLOW_INVALID: The process expired or came from another browser. Start again.
errors.GOOGLE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: This is not the linked Google account. Start again with the right one.
errors.GOOGLE_IDENTITY_TAKEN: This Google account is already linked to another account.
errors.GOOGLE_ALREADY_LINKED: A Google account is already linked.
errors.GOOGLE_REJECTED: Google refused the sign-in. Start again or choose another way.
errors.GOOGLE_UNAVAILABLE: Google is not responding. Try again in a moment.
errors.INVITATION_REQUIRED: Sign-up is by invitation only for now.
errors.TOTP_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED: This account must first enable a second factor.
errors.generic: That did not work. Go back to sign in and try again.

transferPanel.title: Change account
transferPanel.who: The profile keeps everything that references it. You give the origin account’s consent; the profile and the destination account give theirs, then the change happens 48 hours after the last consent. Anyone can cancel before then.

kinds.DETACH: Create a new account for this profile

transferPanel.emailHint: The profile will see it on its consent screen. A setup link will be sent there.
transferPanel.regroup: This is the last profile of this account: the account will be deleted when the move happens (regrouping).
transferPanel.pinChoice: What happens to the profile’s PIN?
transferPanel.noneWarning: Between profiles of the same account, a surprise stays secret only through the PIN: without one, the other profiles of the destination account could see what this profile prepares for them.

token.once: Pass this token to the holder of the destination account. It will not be shown again and is valid for 7 days.

current.title: Request in progress
current.move: Move to another account in progress.
current.detach: Detachment into a new account in progress.
current.profileOk: The profile has given its consent.
current.profileWaiting: The profile has not yet given its consent.
current.profileNotRequired: The profile’s consent is not required.
current.destinationWaiting: The destination account has not accepted yet.
current.expires: The request expires on {date} if it is not complete.

incoming.title: Receive a profile
incoming.who: Another account wants to hand you a profile. You only receive one from an account where a profile is in the leaving profile’s circle.
incoming.tokenHint: The token you were given (43 characters).
incoming.tokenInvalid: This token does not have the right shape.
incoming.refused: This token is not accepted. We do not say why.
incoming.preview: This profile would join your account, with everything that references it.
incoming.previewChild: This child profile would join your account, with everything that references it.
incoming.pinWarning: Between profiles of the same account, a surprise stays secret only through the profile’s PIN. A profile without a PIN lets the other profiles of the account see what it prepares.

ownTransfer.title: Account change request
ownTransfer.detach: Your profile will become a separate account, at the address {email}. Check it: if it is not yours, refuse.
ownTransfer.move: Your profile will move to the account that contains: {names}.
ownTransfer.regroup: This profile is the last of its current account: that account will be deleted when it moves.
ownTransfer.expires: The request expires on {date} if it is not complete.
ownTransfer.cancelAnytime: You, the origin account or the destination account can cancel until it runs.
ownTransfer.pinChoice: What happens to your PIN in the new account?
ownTransfer.noneWarning: Without a PIN, anyone who opens the destination account can enter this profile and see its surprises.

wards.title: Wards
wards.who: A ward account belongs to a child who lives elsewhere and signs in alone. You keep safeguards, never access to its content: each action asks you to confirm it is you, and the child is told.
wards.detailWho: You only see this account’s address, profiles and sessions.
wards.sessions: {count, plural, =0 {No open sessions} one {One open session} other {# open sessions}}
wards.resetBody: A link is sent to your address, and all its sessions are closed. The child is told.
wards.releaseBody: Only possible if it has a single profile. It takes effect when the child declares their age from their Account space.
wards.releasePending: Release requested: it takes effect when the child declares their age.
wards.addProfileHint: The name of the profile to create in this account.
wards.nameInvalid: Give a name of 1 to 60 characters.
wards.guardianRequired: Tick the box to declare your parental authority.

done.reset: Reset link sent to your address.

create.title: Create a ward account
create.who: A setup link is sent to the address given; whoever opens it chooses a password.
create.email: Email address of the child’s account
create.guardian: I declare that I have parental authority over this child.
create.sent: Account created: a setup link has just been sent.

release.title: End of guardianship
release.who: If your guardian has asked to lift the guardianship, declare your age to become independent. Otherwise, do nothing here.
release.done: Done: this account is now independent.

lists.title: Lists
lists.who: Here are your lists and the ones shown to you.
lists.trashHint: A deleted list stays in the bin for 30 days, then disappears.
lists.teaser: A gift list is being prepared for you.

create.title: New list
create.wishlist: Wishlist: what I would like to receive
create.giftlist: Gift list: what we are preparing for someone
create.name: Title
create.recipientsWishlist: You, or a profile of your account.
create.recipientsGiftlist: One or more profiles from your circle. They will see nothing unless you decide so.
create.whoWishlist: Your circle will see this list.
create.whoGiftlist: Only the members you invite will see this list. Its recipients will not.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.LIST_NOT_FOUND: This list does not exist or is not shown to you.
errors.ITEM_NOT_FOUND: This item does not exist or is not shown to you.
errors.LIST_ACTION_FORBIDDEN: You cannot do this on this list.
errors.VISIBILITY_EDIT_FORBIDDEN: You cannot change who sees this item.
errors.RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED: This profile cannot be a recipient of this list.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_ALLOWED: This profile cannot be a member of this list.
errors.SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED: First choose a manager among the members.
errors.PERSONAL_LIST_LOCKED: “My wishes” cannot be deleted, archived or left.
errors.GIFT_SETTINGS_INCONSISTENT: To show gifts, first reveal that the list exists.
errors.VISIBILITY_ENGAGED_PROFILE: Someone has committed to this item: let them know before hiding it from them.
errors.VISIBILITY_PROFILE_INVALID: This profile cannot be part of this choice.
errors.VERSION_MISMATCH: Someone changed this in the meantime. Reload the page.
errors.PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: This product does not exist or is not shown to you.
errors.HIDDEN_ITEM_REQUIRES_CHOICE: This item is hidden from some people: choose how to publish it.
errors.GLOBAL_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE: The public catalogue is not available yet.
errors.EXTRACTION_RATE_LIMITED: You added many items at once. Try again later, or fill in the product by hand.
errors.IMAGE_REJECTED: This image cannot be used. Try a JPEG or PNG photo.
errors.FETCHER_UNAVAILABLE: Photo analysis is unavailable right now. Fill in the product by hand.
errors.PRODUCT_URL_INVALID: This link is not a web address.
errors.ITEM_INVALID: Some item information is not valid.
errors.LIST_INVALID: Some list information is not valid.

list.deleteBody: It stays in your bin for 30 days, then disappears with its items.
list.leaveBody: You will no longer see it unless invited again.
list.leaveSuccessor: Before leaving, choose a manager among the members.

members.title: Members
members.who: Members see the list; recipients of a gift list are never members.

gift.title: What the recipient sees
gift.HIDDEN: Hidden: nothing appears for the recipient
gift.REVEALED: Revealed: they see a list is being prepared for them
gift.never: They never see who contributes, the amounts, or the givers’ thread.
gift.sharedAccount: A recipient shares an account with a giver: the secret depends on their profile PIN.

item.deleteBody: It disappears from the list for everyone.

whoSees.title: Who sees this?
whoSees.hintOnly: Someone added to the list later will not see this item.
whoSees.hintExcept: Someone added to the list later will see this item.
whoSees.outside: Some chosen people do not see the list, so they will not see the item either. Add them to the list so they can.

add.title: Add a wish
add.suggestionWho: Your suggestion is seen by the other givers, never by the recipient.
add.who: Visible to the list audience, following its default rule.
add.urlHint: The product fills itself in; you check it before adding it.
add.photo: Photo of the item, its label or the receipt
add.photoHint: Location and device data are removed from the photo.
add.name: Title
add.priceHint: Without a price, everyone contributes what they want.
add.offlineLink: Offline: the link is saved and the item will be read when you're back online.
add.offlinePhoto: Adding by photo needs a connection.

draft.title: Product
draft.who: Only you can see this product until you publish it.
draft.failed: This website does not let us read the page. Fill in the product, the link is kept.

share.title: Sharing in the directory
share.CIRCLE: Your circle sees it in the directory
share.hiddenBody: This item is hidden from some people. Publishing it could give them an idea of what you are preparing.
share.makeAll: Make it visible to everyone and publish it
share.someOnly: Share it only with some people
share.someOnlyHint: Open the item in its list and choose “Who sees this?”.

directory.title: Directory
directory.who: Products your circle chose to share. Nothing here says which list they are in.

events.title: Events
events.whoList: Events this profile is invited to. Only their participants see them.
events.who: Visible to the event’s participants, and only to them.
events.whoSurprise: Visible to participants only. The people being celebrated are not invited and see nothing.
events.sharedAccount: A participant shares an account with someone being celebrated: the surprise holds only if every profile on that account has its PIN.

create.title: New event
create.who: Only the profiles you invite will see it.
create.whoSurprise: Only the profiles you invite will see it. The people being celebrated will know nothing.
create.name: Name
create.honoreeMode: One or more people being celebrated
create.honoreesHint: Choose from your circle. The other guests give them presents.
create.surpriseHint: The people being celebrated are not invited and see neither the event nor its lists.
create.exchangeHint: Everyone gives and receives: each participant brings their list.

errors.EVENT_ACTION_FORBIDDEN: You can’t do that on this event.
errors.EVENT_INVALID: Some information isn’t valid. Check the fields.
errors.EVENT_DATE_PASSED: This date has passed. Choose today or later.
errors.EVENT_HONOREE_CANNOT_PARTICIPATE: This profile is being celebrated by the surprise: it can’t be invited.
errors.EVENT_PROFILE_NOT_ALLOWED: This profile can’t be added to this event.
errors.EVENT_CHILD_OUTSIDE_CIRCLE: A child profile only joins an event through someone in its circle.
errors.CARRY_NOT_ALLOWED: This wish can’t be carried over.
errors.VERSION_MISMATCH: The event changed in the meantime. Reload the page.
errors.network: Can’t connect. Check your network and try again.

invite.title: Invite people
invite.who: Profiles from your circle. Their account gets an email that says nothing about the event.
invite.empty: Everyone in your circle is already invited.

links.title: Invitation link
links.who: Anyone with the link and an account can join the event, until its date.
links.once: Copy it now: it won’t be shown again.

progress.title: Progress
progress.everyone: Everyone already has at least one present planned.
progress.who: Visible to givers only. Your own lists never count.

lists.title: Event lists
lists.reception: The event is over: open your list and tick what you received.

manage.title: Organising
manage.cancelConfirm: Cancel the event? Its lists become read-only.
manage.deleteConfirm: Delete the event? Its lists will be detached.

assistant.title: Build my list
assistant.who: Your list is visible to participants who answered “Going” or “Maybe”.
assistant.noList: No list to fill in. Go back to the event.
assistant.newHint: Add an item by link, photo or by hand, from your list.

carry.who: Your wishes from past events that you haven’t ticked “received”.
carry.submit: {count, plural, one {Carry over this wish} other {Carry over these # wishes}}

ideas.who: In “My wishes” and in others’ lists you can see. They aren’t told.

join.title: Event invitation
join.who: Only the active profile joins. To add another profile, switch profiles and reopen the link.

threads.title: Discussion: {item}
threads.publicClosed: No thread with the recipients: they don’t see this item.
threads.audienceGivers: The recipients won’t see this message.
threads.audienceAll: Visible to the recipients and everyone who sees this item.
threads.audienceSelf: Visible to everyone who sees this item.
threads.readOnly: This list is archived: no new messages.
threads.error: The message could not be sent.

types.event_day_after: “{title}” is over: tick what you received

notificationPrefs.title: Notifications
notificationPrefs.caption: What you receive, and how
notificationPrefs.securityLocked: Security alerts can’t be turned off.
notificationPrefs.quietEnabled: No device notifications during these hours
notificationPrefs.digestWho: Sent to the account address, shared by all its profiles: it only gives the number of notifications per profile, never their content.
notificationPrefs.sharePresence: Show other givers that I’m looking or typing

accounting.title: Give: {item}
accounting.whoSees: Visible to the givers of this item; never to its recipient. Each amount is read by participants only.
accounting.reviewCost: The price changed: apply the new cost to the shares?
accounting.shortfall: {amount} is left to cover. Let the other participants know?
accounting.shortfallPrivate: Only you will know who you told.
accounting.cartEmpty: You are not the buyer of any gift yet.
accounting.remainingForYou: {amount} left for you if nobody completes it
accounting.balancesPrivate: Everyone only sees what concerns them.
accounting.offsetProposed: Offer sent: the other person has to confirm it.
accounting.budgetPrivate: Your budget is visible to you only.

options.title: Options
options.summary: review {review, select, on {on} other {off}}, receipt {receipt, select, on {requested} other {not requested}}
options.whoSees: Set and read by participants only, never by the recipient.
options.review: Another participant approves price and option changes
options.receipt: The buyer attaches a photo of the receipt
options.needsReview: With review on, your change will wait for another participant to agree.

buyerRequest.title: Change of buyer
buyerRequest.mine: You offered to become the buyer. Waiting for an answer.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.add: Attach a photo of the receipt
receipt.privacy: The photo is stripped of its metadata and shown to participants only.

offset.title: Pending offsets
offset.stale: The balances changed since the offer: it is no longer valid. Make a new one.

errors.CONTRIBUTION_EXCEEDS_REMAINING: Someone just completed this gift: the remaining amount changed.
errors.CONTRIBUTION_FROZEN: The purchase is checked: ask the buyer to correct it.
errors.CONTRIBUTION_SETTLED: Part of it is already settled: the buyer has to cancel that first.
errors.ACCOUNTING_CLOSED: This gift no longer accepts shares.
errors.ACCOUNTING_ACTION_FORBIDDEN: This action belongs to someone else.
errors.PURCHASE_UNCHECK_CONFIRM: The purchase is more than 24 hours old: confirm to uncheck it.

pending.contribution_put: Your contribution {amount} is to be confirmed: it doesn't count yet.
pending.contribution_delete: Withdrawing your contribution is to be confirmed.

offlineActions.title: Waiting actions
offlineActions.intro: What you did without a connection is sent as soon as it's back. Nothing is lost without an explanation.
offlineActions.chooseFields: Someone changed this wish in the meantime. Choose, field by field, which value to keep.
offlineActions.sameNow: Both versions are now the same.

reasons.expired: Waited more than 30 days: it was not sent, so it can't count twice.
reasons.conflict: Someone changed the same thing in the meantime.
reasons.gone: This wish no longer exists, or you can no longer see it.
reasons.forbidden: You can no longer do this.
reasons.refused: The server did not accept this.
reasons.CONTRIBUTION_EXCEEDS_REMAINING: Someone completed it in the meantime: there was less left to cover.
reasons.ACCOUNTING_CLOSED: This gift no longer accepts contributions.
reasons.CONTRIBUTION_FROZEN: The purchase is already checked: ask the buyer.
reasons.CONTRIBUTION_SETTLED: Part of it is already paid: the buyer must undo it first.
reasons.ITEM_NOT_FOUND: This wish no longer exists, or you can no longer see it.
reasons.LIST_NOT_FOUND: This list no longer exists, or you can no longer see it.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: This page hasn't been opened on this device yet. The lists and cart you've already viewed are still available.

pwa.installBody: Add the app to your home screen: it opens even without a connection, and "Share" from a website adds a wish in two taps.
pwa.installIos: On iPhone: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
pwa.pushBody: Get an alert when someone replies or a gift moves forward. The message stays discreet: it never says what's being prepared.
pwa.pushOn: Notifications are on for this device.
pwa.pushFailed: Notifications couldn't be turned on. Try again later.

connection.offline: Offline: what you do will be sent when you're back online.
connection.offlineSince: Offline since {time}: what you do will be sent when you're back online.

share.title: Add a wish
share.noLink: No link received: choose the list, then paste the link or type the wish.
share.noList: You don't have a list yet. Create one from "Lists".
